# Merriam-Webster

> America's most trusted dictionary and language reference resource, offering comprehensive definitions, synonyms, word games, and vocabulary tools for English language learners and enthusiasts.

Merriam-Webster provides over 300,000 definitions through its dictionary and thesaurus tools, along with mobile apps for iOS and Android, daily word features, and official SCRABBLE resources. The platform serves as a comprehensive English language reference for writers, students, and word game players.

## Key Topics

- Dictionary definitions
- Thesaurus and synonyms
- Word of the Day
- SCRABBLE resources
- Vocabulary building
- Language learning
- Antonyms and word relationships
- Writing tools
- Mobile dictionary apps
- English language reference
- Word games
- Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary
- Learner's Dictionary
- Daily vocabulary calendar

## Core Dictionary & Thesaurus Tools

- [Merriam-Webster: America's Most Trusted Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/): Homepage for America's most trusted dictionary with 300,000+ definitions
- [Thesaurus by Merriam-Webster: Find Synonyms, Similar Words, and Antonyms](https://www.merriam-webster.com/thesaurus): Thesaurus tool for finding synonyms, antonyms, and similar words

## Vocabulary & Learning Features

- [Word of the Day Calendar | Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/word-of-the-day/calendar): Daily vocabulary calendar featuring Word of the Day entries

## Mobile Apps & Digital Tools

- [Dictionary and Word Game Apps | Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/apps): Mobile apps including dictionary, Scrabble, and word game downloads
